note: #174 (fix/diffgate-174-175): pinned claims that main's reading of a rename's old path in `only_touches` moves, in both ports, each from the record pinned in its file to the record now, in the form of issue205_moves.json. from: VERIFIED withheld by PATH-2a (#121): with leading dots kept, no changed path has the prefix as a segment, so it is not read as a path. main's reading: all changed paths under prefix
